media.alt_text: Glasgow Cathedral's medieval stone exterior in Glasgow, Scotland

caption.body:
Glasgow Cathedral — medieval, atmospheric, and free to visit. The lower church is worth spending time in, and the Glasgow Necropolis behind it (a Victorian cemetery on the hill) has great views across the city.

Glasgow was also better for GF dining than its reputation suggests. 10 restaurants tested, with Red Onion (dedicated GF menu) and Browns (Coeliac UK accredited) both scoring 5/5.

Full Glasgow guide on the site (link in bio).
